title: Plasma membrane labelling efficiency, internalization and partitioning of functionalized fluorescent lipids as a function of lipid structure
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, 6,1640-1649
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00116A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Erdinc Sezgin
Labeling the plasma membrane is challenging due to probe internalization, photobleaching, and signal loss. We compared lipid-based probes and identified a superior one that efficiently labels membranes in live, fixed, and permeabilized cells.
